**Group departure dates:** 2 August 2026; 16 August 2026; 30 August 2026; 27 September 2026; 18 October 2026; 8 November 2026; 6 December 2026

## Journey highlights

After breakfast, a half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area, restaurant and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. Then drive to the central districts of old Rio to admire its old churches, monasteries, the city’s cathedral and colonial-style buildings.

After breakfast, a tour through the city to the station, where an eco-friendly train climbs through the jungle to the top of Corcovado, with spectacular views of the Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys and exotic birds. At the summit, 710 metres above sea level, stands the symbol of Rio, the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the city and its surroundings: the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, the legendary Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf and more.

After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu, where you are welcomed and taken to your hotel. Then set off on a tour of the falls. On the border of Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay, within a national park of unique flora and fauna, 275 waterfalls, each with its own name, crash into the canyon of the Devil’s Throat; their name means “big water” in Guarani. The contrast between the calm, almost lazy river above the falls and the boiling torrents plunging into the gorge below is stunning: you could watch this spectacle for hours.

Optional, at an additional cost: the Macuco Safari and the Bird Park (see Optional excursions).

After breakfast, cross the Tancredo Neves Bridge over the Iguazu River to the Argentine side of the falls, which is different from the Brazilian one: here you stand under and above the falls at the same time, feeling the power of the falling water very close to you, and enjoy the national park around this astonishing beauty. See the source of the Devil’s Throat.

Day 6 · After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Rio. On arrival, your driver takes you to Búzios, where your hotel is on the tropical coast.

Day 7 · A free day to enjoy the many activities of Búzios’ tropical coast and relax on one of its many beautiful beaches.

## Tour format

Accommodation is in hotels along the route.

Excursions are in a group with an English-speaking guide.

Group transfers are with a driver.

Domestic flights Rio de Janeiro – Iguazu – Rio de Janeiro are not included. Prices start from USD 650.

Additional excursions in Iguazu are charged separately.
